A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DC-AE research. The complete main text, Appendices A–I, equations, tables and figures are readable and can be matched across versions.

before.justification: v6 reports original reconstruction, image-generation, efficiency and ablation results, including Tables 1–7 and Figures 3, 11 and 12.

after.justification: v7 retains these original experiments and adds further reported evaluation metrics for SiT-XL with DC-AE in Table 7.

M1.justification: Residual Autoencoding, Decoupled High-Resolution Adaptation, training losses and diffusion integration remain unchanged. The redrawn Figure 4 illustrates operations already specified in Section 3.2; it does not establish an architectural change.

E1.justification: Dataset and task coverage remains unchanged, including ImageNet, SAM, FFHQ, MapillaryVistas and MJHQ. The additional Table 7 entries concern the existing ImageNet 512×512 class-conditional generation setting.

E2.justification: Table 7 expands its comparison to include MAGVIT-v2, EDM2-XXL, MAR-L and SiT-XL. These methods already appeared in Table 3; the substantive extension is their participation in additional metric comparisons, particularly inception scores for MAGVIT-v2/MAR-L and the broader metrics for SiT-XL. EDM2-XXL's FID entry only repeats existing results.

E3.justification: The stated splits, training budgets, model configurations, patch sizes, samplers, guidance settings and metric suite are unchanged. Table 7 supplies additional results under existing settings without documenting a revised evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: The residual-autoencoding, resolution-adaptation, patch-size, model-scaling, layer-count and sampling-hyperparameter analyses are unchanged. Reconstruction and generation samples are also retained; the additional benchmark metrics introduce no distinct ablation or robustness analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without adding repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests. The expanded table retains the existing statistical reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 7 adds SiT-XL/DC-AE-f32 inception scores of 131.37/237.71, precision of 0.77/0.82, recall of 0.65/0.58 and CMMD of 0.36/0.23, respectively without/with CFG. It also adds inception scores for MAGVIT-v2 (213.1/324.3) and MAR-L (205.2/279.9). Existing results are unchanged; the added rows' FIDs were already reported in v6 Table 3.

T1.justification: The space-to-channel, channel-averaging and channel-duplication equations are unchanged. Figure 4's new dimension labels explain existing operations without introducing new mathematical assumptions, definitions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims, including compression ratios up to 128 and the UViT-H training/inference speedups of 17.9×/19.1×. The additional metrics do not alter these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning optimization difficulty, cross-resolution generalization, GAN-based local refinement and model capacity remain unchanged. No substantive limitations, applicability boundaries or failure explanations are added or removed.

D1.justification: Replacing Figure 4 removes the explicit SD-VAE/DC-AE middle-stage layer schematic, including the 1024-to-32-channel shortcut example. The new block diagrams elaborate operations already described by equations. Training hyperparameters, hardware, sampling details and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning and cited-work set are unchanged. Citations added within Table 7 refer to existing bibliography entries; changed citation page references reflect table placement and pagination.

P1.justification: Figure 4's panel descriptions are rewritten and its caption adds definitions of C and R. Otherwise, the main prose and appendix narrative remain essentially verbatim, without substantial restructuring.

P2.justification: Figure 4 replaces the SD-VAE/DC-AE architecture comparison with dimension-annotated downsampling and upsampling diagrams. Table 7 gains four rows and moves to a separate page, with accompanying reflow of Appendix I and Figure 13. Other visual content is retained.

improvement.justification: The additional Table 7 metrics make the empirical comparison more complete beyond the previously reported FIDs, while Figure 4 clarifies shortcut channel handling. These are limited gains, partly offset by removal of the middle-stage schematic and unchanged prose references to the obsolete Figure 4 panel arrangement. The central method and conclusions remain stable.
